ततश् चाहं प्रहृष्टात्मा कुशान् आदाय सत्वरम्
हस्तं देवस्य देव्याश् च योगबन्धेन युक्तवान् ॥
36.m: Brahmā said: / Then, delighted in my heart, taking kuśa grass swiftly, / I joined the hand of the god and of the goddess with the bond of union.

36.s:
jvalanaś ca svayaṃ tatra kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ
śrutigītair mahāmantrair mūrtimadbhir upasthitaiḥ //
36.d:
ज्वलनश् च स्वयं तत्र कृताञ्जलिपुटः स्थितः
श्रुतिगीतैर् महामन्त्रैर् मूर्तिमद्भिर् उपस्थितैः ॥
36.m: And the Fire himself stood there with hands folded in reverent greeting, / attended by the great mantras sung by the Vedas present in bodily form.

36.s:
yathoktavidhinā hutvā sarpis tad amṛtaṃ haviḥ
tatas taṃ jvalanaṃ sarvaṃ kārayitvā pradakṣiṇam //
36.d:
यथोक्तविधिना हुत्वा सर्पिस् तद् अमृतं हविः
ततस् तं ज्वलनं सर्वं कारयित्वा प्रदक्षिणम् ॥
36.m: Having offered according to the prescribed rule the clarified butter, that immortal oblation, / and having then caused them to make a full circumambulation of that fire,

36.s:
muktvā hastasamāyogaṃ sahitaḥ sarvadaivataiḥ
putraiś ca mānasaiḥ siddhaiḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā //
36.d:
मुक्त्वा हस्तसमायोगं सहितः सर्वदैवतैः
पुत्रैश् च मानसैः सिद्धैः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना ॥
36.m: releasing the clasping of hands, together with all the deities, / his mind-born sons, and the Siddhas, with a rejoiced inner self,

36.s:
vṛtta udvāhakāle tu praṇamya ca vṛṣadhvajam
yogenaiva tayor viprās tad umāparameśayoḥ //
36.d:
वृत्त उद्वाहकाले तु प्रणम्य च वृषध्वजम्
योगेनैव तयोर् विप्रास् तद् उमापरमेशयोः ॥
36.m: and bowing to the bull-bannered god when the wedding moment had passed, / through that very union of those two, O brahmins, of Umā and the Supreme Lord,

36.s:
udvāhaḥ sa paro vṛtto yaṃ devā na viduḥ kvacit
iti vaḥ sarvam ākhyātaṃ svayaṃvaram idaṃ śubham
udvāhaś caiva devasya śṛṇudhvaṃ paramādbhutam //
36.d:
उद्वाहः स परो वृत्तो यं देवा न विदुः क्वचित्
इति वः सर्वम् आख्यातं स्वयंवरम् इदं शुभम्
उद्वाहश् चैव देवस्य शृणुध्वं परमाद्भुतम् ॥
36.m: that highest marriage was accomplished, which the gods never knew before. / Thus this auspicious choice of a husband has been recounted to you all, / as well as the wedding of the god; hear [now] the supreme marvel!

37.s:
brahmovāca
atha vṛtte vivāhe tu bhavasyāmitatejasaḥ
praharṣam atulaṃ gatvā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ
tuṣṭuvur vāgbhir ādyābhiḥ praṇemus te maheśvaram //
37.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
अथ वृत्ते विवाहे तु भवस्यामिततेजसः
प्रहर्षम् अतुलं गत्वा देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः
तुष्टुवुर् वाग्भिर् आद्याभिः प्रणेमुस् ते महेश्वरम् ॥
37.m: Brahmā said: / Now when the marriage of Bhava of boundless splendor was concluded, / the gods, preceded by Indra, experienced matchless delight; / they praised Maheśvara with primordial words and bowed down to him.

37.s:
devā ūcuḥ
namaḥ parvataliṅgāya parvateśāya vai namaḥ
namaḥ pavanavegāya virūpāyājitāya ca
namaḥ kleśavināśāya dātre ca śubhasaṃpadām //
37.d:
देवा ऊचुः
नमः पर्वतलिङ्गाय पर्वतेशाय वै नमः
नमः पवनवेगाय विरूपायाजिताय च
नमः क्लेशविनाशाय दात्रे च शुभसंपदाम् ॥
37.m: The gods said: / 'Salutations to the one whose emblem is the mountain, salutations to the Lord of the mountain! / Salutations to the one swift as the wind, to the multiform, and to the unconquered! / Salutations to the destroyer of affliction and the giver of auspicious fortunes!

37.s:
namo nīlaśikhaṇḍāya ambikāpataye namaḥ
namaḥ pavanarūpāya śatarūpāya vai namaḥ //
37.d:
नमो नीलशिखण्डाय अम्बिकापतये नमः
नमः पवनरूपाय शतरूपाय वै नमः ॥
37.m: Salutations to the one with the dark crest! Salutations to the lord of Ambikā! / Salutations to the one whose form is the wind! Salutations to the one of a hundred forms!

37.s:
namo bhairavarūpāya virūpanayanāya ca
namaḥ sahasranetrāya sahasracaraṇāya ca //
37.d:
नमो भैरवरूपाय विरूपनयनाय च
नमः सहस्रनेत्राय सहस्रचरणाय च ॥
37.m: Salutations to the one whose form is terrible, and to the one of multiform eyes! / Salutations to the thousand-eyed one and to the thousand-footed one!

37.s:
namo devavayasyāya vedāṅgāya namo namaḥ
viṣṭambhanāya śakrasya bāhvor vedāṅkurāya ca //
37.d:
नमो देववयस्याय वेदाङ्गाय नमो नमः
विष्टम्भनाय शक्रस्य बाह्वोर् वेदाङ्कुराय च ॥
37.m: Salutations to the companion of gods! Salutations, salutations to the limb of the Veda! / Salutations to the paralyser of Indra's arms, and to the sprout of the Veda!

37.s:
carācarādhipataye śamanāya namo namaḥ
salilāśayaliṅgāya yugāntāya namo namaḥ //
37.d:
चराचराधिपतये शमनाय नमो नमः
सलिलाशयलिङ्गाय युगान्ताय नमो नमः ॥
37.m: Salutations, salutations to the sovereign of the moving and unmoving, to the restrainer! / Salutations, salutations to the one whose emblem is water reservoirs, to the end of the cosmic age!

37.s:
namaḥ kapālamālāya kapālasūtradhāriṇe
namaḥ kapālahastāya daṇḍine gadine namaḥ //
37.d:
नमः कपालमालाय कपालसूत्रधारिणे
नमः कपालहस्ताय दण्डिने गदिने नमः ॥
37.m: Salutations to the one garlanded with skulls, to the bearer of the skull-cord! / Salutations to the one with a skull in hand, to the staff-bearer, salutations to the mace-bearer!

37.s:
namas trailokyanāthāya paśulokaratāya ca
namaḥ khaṭvāṅgahastāya pramathārtiharāya ca //
37.d:
नमस् त्रैलोक्यनाथाय पशुलोकरताय च
नमः खट्वाङ्गहस्ताय प्रमथार्तिहराय च ॥
37.m: Salutations to the protector of the three worlds, and to the one delighting in the world of beasts! / Salutations to the one with a club in hand, and to the remover of the distress of the attendants!

37.s:
namo yajñaśirohantre kṛṣṇakeśāpahāriṇe
bhaganetranipātāya pūṣṇo dantaharāya ca //
37.d:
नमो यज्ञशिरोहन्त्रे कृष्णकेशापहारिणे
भगनेत्रनिपाताय पूष्णो दन्तहराय च ॥
37.m: Salutations to the destroyer of the head of the sacrifice, to the remover of the black hair! / Salutations to the smiter of Bhaga's eye, and to the extractor of Pūṣan's teeth!

37.s:
namaḥ pinākaśūlāsikhaḍgamudgaradhāriṇe
namo 'stu kālakālāya tṛtīyanayanāya ca //
37.d:
नमः पिनाकशूलासिखड्गमुद्गरधारिणे
नमो ऽस्तु कालकालाय तृतीयनयनाय च ॥
37.m: Salutations to the bearer of the Pināka bow, the trident, the sword, the scimitar, and the mallet! / Salutations be to the death of Death, and to the three-eyed one!

37.s:
antakāntakṛte caiva namaḥ parvatavāsine
suvarṇaretase caiva namaḥ kuṇḍaladhāriṇe //
37.d:
अन्तकान्तकृते चैव नमः पर्वतवासिने
सुवर्णरेतसे चैव नमः कुण्डलधारिणे ॥
37.m: Salutations to the one who makes an end of the Ender, and to the dweller on the mountain! / Salutations to the one whose semen is gold, and to the wearer of earrings!

37.s:
daityānāṃ yoganāśāya yogināṃ gurave namaḥ
śaśāṅkādityanetrāya lalāṭanayanāya ca //
37.d:
दैत्यानां योगनाशाय योगिनां गुरवे नमः
शशाङ्कादित्यनेत्राय ललाटनयनाय च ॥
37.m: Salutations to the destroyer of the magical power of the Daityas, to the teacher of yogins! / Salutations to the one whose eyes are the moon and the sun, and to the one with an eye on his forehead!

37.s:
namaḥ śmaśānarataye śmaśānavaradāya ca
namo daivatanāthāya tryambakāya namo namaḥ //
37.d:
नमः श्मशानरतये श्मशानवरदाय च
नमो दैवतनाथाय त्र्यम्बकाय नमो नमः ॥
37.m: Salutations to the one delighting in cremation grounds, to the giver of boons in the cremation ground! / Salutations to the lord of deities! Salutations, salutations to Tryambaka!

37.s:
gṛhasthasādhave nityaṃ jaṭile brahmacāriṇe
namo muṇḍārdhamuṇḍāya paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ //
37.d:
गृहस्थसाधवे नित्यं जटिले ब्रह्मचारिणे
नमो मुण्डार्धमुण्डाय पशूनां पतये नमः ॥
37.m: To the ever virtuous householder, to the matted-haired ascetic student! / Salutations to the shaven-headed and half-shaven, salutations to the lord of beasts!

37.s:
salile tapyamānāya yogaiśvaryapradāya ca
namaḥ śāntāya dāntāya pralayotpattikāriṇe //
37.d:
सलिले तप्यमानाय योगैश्वर्यप्रदाय च
नमः शान्ताय दान्ताय प्रलयोत्पत्तिकारिणे ॥
37.m: To the one performing tapas in the water, and to the giver of sovereignty through yoga! / Salutations to the peaceful, the restrained, the cause of dissolution and origination!

37.s:
namo 'nugrahakartre ca sthitikartre namo namaḥ
namo rudrāya vasava ādityāyāśvine namaḥ //
37.d:
नमो ऽनुग्रहकर्त्रे च स्थितिकर्त्रे नमो नमः
नमो रुद्राय वसव आदित्यायाश्विने नमः ॥
37.m: Salutations to the granter of grace, salutations, salutations to the author of preservation! / Salutations to Rudra, to the Vasu, to the Āditya, salutations to the Aśvin!

37.s:
namaḥ pitre 'tha sāṃkhyāya viśvedevāya vai namaḥ
namaḥ śarvāya ugrāya śivāya varadāya ca //
37.d:
नमः पित्रे ऽथ सांख्याय विश्वेदेवाय वै नमः
नमः शर्वाय उग्राय शिवाय वरदाय च ॥
37.m: Salutations to the ancestor, to Sāṃkhya, salutations indeed to the Viśvedevas! / Salutations to Śarva, to the fierce, to the auspicious, and to the giver of boons!

37.s:
namo bhīmāya senānye paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ
śucaye vairihānāya sadyojātāya vai namaḥ //
37.d:
नमो भीमाय सेनान्ये पशूनां पतये नमः
शुचये वैरिहानाय सद्योजाताय वै नमः ॥
37.m: Salutations to the formidable, to the commander of the army, salutations to the lord of beasts! / Salutations indeed to the pure, to the destroyer of enemies, to Sadyojāta!

37.s:
mahādevāya citrāya vicitrāya ca vai namaḥ
pradhānāyāprameyāya kāryāya kāraṇāya ca //
37.d:
महादेवाय चित्राय विचित्राय च वै नमः
प्रधानायाप्रमेयाय कार्याय कारणाय च ॥
37.m: Salutations to the great god, to the wondrous, and indeed to the variegated! / Salutations to pradhāna, to the immeasurable, to effect and to cause!

37.s:
puruṣāya namas te 'stu puruṣecchākarāya ca
namaḥ puruṣasaṃyogapradhānaguṇakāriṇe //
37.d:
पुरुषाय नमस् ते ऽस्तु पुरुषेच्छाकराय च
नमः पुरुषसंयोगप्रधानगुणकारिणे ॥
37.m: Salutations be to you, the puruṣa, and to the fulfiller of puruṣa's desires! / Salutations to the cause of the qualities of pradhāna through union with puruṣa!

37.s:
pravartakāya prakṛteḥ puruṣasya ca sarvaśaḥ
kṛtākṛtasya satkartre phalasaṃyogadāya ca //
37.d:
प्रवर्तकाय प्रकृतेः पुरुषस्य च सर्वशः
कृताकृतस्य सत्कर्त्रे फलसंयोगदाय च ॥
37.m: To the instigator of prakṛti and of puruṣa in every way, / to the right creator of what is done and undone, and to the giver of the union with fruits!

37.s:
kālajñāya ca sarveṣāṃ namo niyamakāriṇe
namo vaiṣamyakartre ca guṇānāṃ vṛttidāya ca //
37.d:
कालज्ञाय च सर्वेषां नमो नियमकारिणे
नमो वैषम्यकर्त्रे च गुणानां वृत्तिदाय च ॥
37.m: To the knower of time, and salutations to the maker of order for all! / Salutations to the creator of diversity, and to the dispenser of functions of the guṇas!

37.s:
namas te devadeveśa namas te bhūtabhāvana
śiva saumyamukho draṣṭuṃ bhava saumyo hi naḥ prabho //
37.d:
नमस् ते देवदेवेश नमस् ते भूतभावन
शिव सौम्यमुखो द्रष्टुं भव सौम्यो हि नः प्रभो ॥
37.m: Salutations to you, O God of gods! Salutations to you, O source of beings! / O Śiva, gentle-faced to behold, be gentle indeed to us, O Lord!'

37.s:
brahmovāca
evaṃ sa bhagavān devo jagatpatir umāpatiḥ
stūyamānaḥ suraiḥ sarvair amarān idam abravīt //
37.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवं स भगवान् देवो जगत्पतिर् उमापतिः
स्तूयमानः सुरैः सर्वैर् अमरान् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥
37.m: Brahmā said: / Thus praised by all the gods, the blessed god, / the Lord of the world, the husband of Umā, addressed the immortals thus:

37.s:
śrīśaṃkara uvāca
draṣṭuṃ sukhaś ca saumyaś ca devānām asmi bhoḥ surāḥ
varaṃ varayata kṣipraṃ dātāsmi tam asaṃśayam //
37.d:
श्रीशंकर उवाच
द्रष्टुं सुखश् च सौम्यश् च देवानाम् अस्मि भोः सुराः
वरं वरयत क्षिप्रं दातास्मि तम् असंशयम् ॥
37.m: The venerable Śaṅkara said: / 'I am pleasant to behold and gentle to the gods, O deities! / Choose a boon quickly; I shall grant it without doubt.'

37.s:
brahmovāca
tatas te praṇatāḥ sarve surā ūcus trilocanam //
37.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततस् ते प्रणताः सर्वे सुरा ऊचुस् त्रिलोचनम् ॥
37.m: Brahmā said: / Then all those gods bowed down and said to the three-eyed one:

37.s:
devā ūcuḥ
tavaiva bhagavan haste vara eṣo 'vatiṣṭhatām
yadā kāryaṃ tadā nas tvaṃ dāsyase varam īpsitam //
37.d:
देवा ऊचुः
तवैव भगवन् हस्ते वर एषो ऽवतिष्ठताम्
यदा कार्यं तदा नस् त्वं दास्यसे वरम् ईप्सितम् ॥
37.m: The gods said: / 'O Blessed One, let this boon remain in your hand alone: / whenever there is a need, then you will grant us the desired boon.'

37.s:
brahmovāca
evam astv iti tān uktvā visṛjya ca surān haraḥ
lokāṃś ca pramathaiḥ sārdhaṃ viveśa bhavanaṃ svakam //
37.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवम् अस्त्व् इति तान् उक्त्वा विसृज्य च सुरान् हरः
लोकांश् च प्रमथैः सार्धं विवेश भवनं स्वकम् ॥
37.m: Brahmā said: / Saying 'So be it' to them, and dismissing the gods / and the worlds, Hara entered his own dwelling together with his attendants.

37.s:
yas tu harotsavam adbhutam enaṃ
gāyati daivataviprasamakṣam
so 'pratirūpagaṇeśasamāno
dehaviparyayam etya sukhī syāt
37.d:
यस् तु हरोत्सवम् अद्भुतम् एनं
गायति दैवतविप्रसमक्षम्
सो ऽप्रतिरूपगणेशसमानो
देहविपर्ययम् एत्य सुखी स्यात्
37.m: He who sings of this wondrous festival of Hara / in the presence of gods and brahmins / becomes equal to an incomparable lord of gaṇas, / and having undergone the change of body, will be happy.

37.s:
brahmovāca
vipravaryāḥ stavaṃ hīmaṃ śṛṇuyād vā paṭhec ca yaḥ
sa sarvalokago devaiḥ pūjyate 'mararāḍ iva //
37.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
विप्रवर्याः स्तवं हीमं शृणुयाद् वा पठेच् च यः
स सर्वलोकगो देवैः पूज्यते ऽमरराड् इव ॥
37.m: Brahmā said: / O best of brahmins, whoever hears or recites this hymn of praise, / going to all the worlds, is worshipped by the gods like the king of immortals.

38.s:
brahmovāca
praviṣṭe bhavanaṃ deve sūpaviṣṭe varāsane
sa vakro manmathaḥ krūro devaṃ veddhumanā bhavat //
38.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
प्रविष्टे भवनं देवे सूपविष्टे वरासने
स वक्रो मन्मथः क्रूरो देवं वेद्धुमना भवत् ॥
38.m: Brahmā said: / When the god had entered his dwelling and sat down comfortably on an excellent seat, / crooked, cruel Manmatha became intent on piercing the god—

38.s:
tam anācārasaṃyuktaṃ durātmānaṃ kulādhamam
lokān sarvān pīḍayantaṃ sarvāṅgāvaraṇātmakam //
38.d:
तम् अनाचारसंयुक्तं दुरात्मानं कुलाधमम्
लोकान् सर्वान् पीडयन्तं सर्वाङ्गावरणात्मकम् ॥
38.m: him of immoral conduct, evil-minded, the vilest of his family, / afflicting all the worlds, whose nature envelops all limbs,

38.s:
ṛṣīṇāṃ vighnakartāraṃ niyamānāṃ vrataiḥ saha
cakrāhvayasya rūpeṇa ratyā saha samāgatam //
38.d:
ऋषीणां विघ्नकर्तारं नियमानां व्रतैः सह
चक्राह्वयस्य रूपेण रत्या सह समागतम् ॥
38.m: who obstructs the sages' restraints along with their vows, / who had come together with Rati in the form of a ruddy goose.

38.s:
athātatāyinaṃ viprā veddhukāmaṃ sureśvaraḥ
nayanena tṛtīyena sāvajñaṃ samavaikṣata //
38.d:
अथाततायिनं विप्रा वेद्धुकामं सुरेश्वरः
नयनेन तृतीयेन सावज्ञं समवैक्षत ॥
38.m: Then, O brahmins, the lord of the gods scornfully looked upon the felon, / who was eager to pierce [him], with his third eye.

38.s:
tato 'sya netrajo vahnir jvālāmālāsahasravān
sahasā ratibhartāram adahat saparicchadam //
38.d:
ततो ऽस्य नेत्रजो वह्निर् ज्वालामालासहस्रवान्
सहसा रतिभर्तारम् अदहत् सपरिच्छदम् ॥
38.m: Then the fire born of his eye, possessing thousands of garland-like flames, / suddenly burned Rati's husband along with his equipment.

38.s:
sa dahyamānaḥ karuṇam ārto 'krośata visvaram
prasādayaṃś ca taṃ devaṃ papāta dharaṇītale //
38.d:
स दह्यमानः करुणम् आर्तो ऽक्रोशत विस्वरम्
प्रसादयंश् च तं देवं पपात धरणीतले ॥
38.m: Being burned, afflicted, he cried out pitifully and dissonantly, / and propitiating that god, he fell to the surface of the earth.

38.s:
atha so 'gniparītāṅgo manmatho lokatāpanaḥ
papāta sahasā mūrchāṃ kṣaṇena samapadyata //
38.d:
अथ सो ऽग्निपरीताङ्गो मन्मथो लोकतापनः
पपात सहसा मूर्छां क्षणेन समपद्यत ॥
38.m: Then Manmatha, the tormentor of the worlds, his limbs encompassed by fire, / fell down suddenly and fainted within a moment.

38.s:
patnī tu karuṇaṃ tasya vilalāpa suduḥkhitā
devīṃ devaṃ ca duḥkhārtā ayācat karuṇāvatī //
38.d:
पत्नी तु करुणं तस्य विललाप सुदुःखिता
देवीं देवं च दुःखार्ता अयाचत् करुणावती ॥
38.m: His wife, however, lamented piteously in great sorrow; / stricken with grief, compassionate, she pleaded with the goddess and the god.

38.s:
tasyāś ca karuṇāṃ jñātvā devau tau karuṇātmakau
ūcatus tāṃ samālokya samāśvāsya ca duḥkhitām //
38.d:
तस्याश् च करुणां ज्ञात्वा देवौ तौ करुणात्मकौ
ऊचतुस् तां समालोक्य समाश्वास्य च दुःखिताम् ॥
38.m: Knowing her pity, those two gods, full of compassion, / looked at that sorrowful woman, consoled her, and said:

38.s:
umāmaheśvarāv ūcatuḥ
dagdha eva dhruvaṃ bhadre nāsyotpattir iheṣyate
aśarīro 'pi te bhadre kāryaṃ sarvaṃ kariṣyati //
38.d:
उमामहेश्वराव् ऊचतुः
दग्ध एव ध्रुवं भद्रे नास्योत्पत्तिर् इहेष्यते
अशरीरो ऽपि ते भद्रे कार्यं सर्वं करिष्यति ॥
38.m:
Umā and Maheśvara said:
He is indeed burned, blessed lady; his rebirth here is not desired. / Even though bodiless, blessed lady, he will accomplish all your desires.

38.s:
yadā tu viṣṇur bhagavān vasudevasutaḥ śubhe
tadā tasya suto yaś ca patis te saṃbhaviṣyati //
38.d:
यदा तु विष्णुर् भगवान् वसुदेवसुतः शुभे
तदा तस्य सुतो यश् च पतिस् ते संभविष्यति ॥
38.m: When, however, the blessed Viṣṇu becomes the son of Vasudeva, O auspicious one, / then his son will be born as your husband.

38.s:
brahmovāca
tataḥ sā tu varaṃ labdhvā kāmapatnī śubhānanā
jagāmeṣṭaṃ tadā deśaṃ prītiyuktā gataklamā //
38.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततः सा तु वरं लब्ध्वा कामपत्नी शुभानना
जगामेष्टं तदा देशं प्रीतियुक्ता गतक्लमा ॥
38.m:
Brahmā said:
Then, having obtained the boon, that fair-faced wife of Kāma, / filled with affection and freed from weariness, went to her desired place.

38.s:
dagdhvā kāmaṃ tato viprāḥ sa tu devo vṛṣadhvajaḥ
reme tatromayā sārdhaṃ prahṛṣṭas tu himācale //
38.d:
दग्ध्वा कामं ततो विप्राः स तु देवो वृषध्वजः
रेमे तत्रोमया सार्धं प्रहृष्टस् तु हिमाचले ॥
38.m: Then, having burned Kāma, O brahmins, that bull-bannered god, / filled with delight, sported there on the Himālaya with Umā,

38.s:
kandareṣu ca ramyeṣu padminīṣu guhāsu ca
nirjhareṣu ca ramyeṣu karṇikāravaneṣu ca //
38.d:
कन्दरेषु च रम्येषु पद्मिनीषु गुहासु च
निर्झरेषु च रम्येषु कर्णिकारवनेषु च ॥
38.m: in delightful chasms, lotus ponds, and caves, / by pleasant waterfalls, and in karṇikāra groves,

38.s:
nadītīreṣu kānteṣu kiṃnarācariteṣu ca
śṛṅgeṣu śailarājasya taḍāgeṣu saraḥsu ca //
38.d:
नदीतीरेषु कान्तेषु किंनराचरितेषु च
शृङ्गेषु शैलराजस्य तडागेषु सरःसु च ॥
38.m: on lovely riverbanks frequented by kiṃnaras, / on the peaks of the mountain king, and by ponds and lakes,

38.s:
vanarājiṣu ramyāsu nānāpakṣiruteṣu ca
tīrtheṣu puṇyatoyeṣu munīnām āśrameṣu ca //
38.d:
वनराजिषु रम्यासु नानापक्षिरुतेषु च
तीर्थेषु पुण्यतोयेषु मुनीनाम् आश्रमेषु च ॥
38.m: in beautiful rows of forests resounding with the cries of various birds, / at holy bathing places of sacred water, and in the hermitages of sages.

38.s:
eteṣu puṇyeṣu manohareṣu
deśeṣu vidyādharabhūṣiteṣu
gandharvayakṣāmaraseviteṣu
reme sa devyā sahitas trinetraḥ
38.d:
एतेषु पुण्येषु मनोहरेषु
देशेषु विद्याधरभूषितेषु
गन्धर्वयक्षामरसेवितेषु
रेमे स देव्या सहितस् त्रिनेत्रः
38.m: In these sacred and delightful / places adorned by vidyādharas, / frequented by gandharvas, yakṣas, and immortals, / the three-eyed one sported along with the goddess.

38.s:
devaiḥ sahendrair muniyakṣasiddhair
gandharvavidyādharadaityamukhyaiḥ
anyaiś ca sarvair vividhair vṛto 'sau
tasmin nage harṣam avāpa śaṃbhuḥ
38.d:
देवैः सहेन्द्रैर् मुनियक्षसिद्धैर्
गन्धर्वविद्याधरदैत्यमुख्यैः
अन्यैश् च सर्वैर् विविधैर् वृतो ऽसौ
तस्मिन् नगे हर्षम् अवाप शंभुः
38.m: Accompanied by gods led by Indra, by sages, yakṣas, and siddhas, / by leaders of gandharvas, vidyādharas, and daityas, / and surrounded by various other beings of every kind, / Śambhu found delight on that mountain.

38.s:
nṛtyanti tatrāpsarasaḥ sureśā
gāyanti gandharvagaṇāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ
divyāni vādyāny atha vādayanti
kecid drutaṃ devavaraṃ stuvanti
38.d:
नृत्यन्ति तत्राप्सरसः सुरेशा
गायन्ति गन्धर्वगणाः प्रहृष्टाः
दिव्यानि वाद्यान्य् अथ वादयन्ति
केचिद् द्रुतं देववरं स्तुवन्ति
38.m: There apsarases danced before the lord of the gods, / delighted troops of gandharvas sang, / they played celestial instruments, / and some hastily praised the foremost of gods.

38.s:
evaṃ sa devaḥ svagaṇair upeto
mahābalaiḥ śakrayamāgnitulyaiḥ
devyāḥ priyārthaṃ bhaganetrahantā
giriṃ na tatyāja tadā mahātmā
38.d:
एवं स देवः स्वगणैर् उपेतो
महाबलैः शक्रयमाग्नितुल्यैः
देव्याः प्रियार्थं भगनेत्रहन्ता
गिरिं न तत्याज तदा महात्मा
38.m: Thus accompanied by his own attendants, / mighty and equal to Śakra, Yama, and Agni, / that great-souled slayer of Bhaga's eyes / did not leave the mountain then, for the sake of pleasing the goddess.

38.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
devyāḥ samaṃ tu bhagavāṃs tiṣṭhaṃs tatra sa kāmahā
akarot kiṃ mahādeva etad icchāma veditum //
38.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः
देव्याः समं तु भगवांस् तिष्ठंस् तत्र स कामहा
अकरोत् किं महादेव एतद् इच्छाम वेदितुम् ॥
38.m:
The sages said:
Remaining there together with the goddess, O lord, what did he, / the slayer of Kāma, Mahādeva, do? We wish to know this.

38.s:
brahmovāca
bhagavān himavacchṛṅge sa hi devyāḥ priyecchayā
gaṇeśair vividhākārair hāsaṃ saṃjanayan muhuḥ //
38.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
भगवान् हिमवच्छृङ्गे स हि देव्याः प्रियेच्छया
गणेशैर् विविधाकारैर् हासं संजनयन् मुहुः ॥
38.m:
Brahmā said:
The lord, out of a desire to please the goddess on the peak of the Himālaya, / repeatedly caused laughter by means of troop-leaders of diverse forms.

38.s:
devīṃ bālendutilako ramayaṃś ca rarāma ca
mahānubhāvaiḥ sarvajñaiḥ kāmarūpadharaiḥ śubhaiḥ //
38.d:
देवीं बालेन्दुतिलको रमयंश् च रराम च
महानुभावैः सर्वज्ञैः कामरूपधरैः शुभैः ॥
38.m: Delighting the goddess, he whose forehead-mark is the crescent moon also took delight, / [surrounded] by noble, omniscient, shapeshifting, auspicious [attendants].

38.s:
atha devy āsasādaikā mātaraṃ parameśvarī
āsīnāṃ kāñcane śubhra āsane paramādbhute //
38.d:
अथ देव्य् आससादैका मातरं परमेश्वरी
आसीनां काञ्चने शुभ्र आसने परमाद्भुते ॥
38.m: Then the supreme goddess, alone, approached her mother, / who was seated on a radiant, golden, exceedingly wonderful throne.

38.s:
atha dṛṣṭvā satīṃ devīm āgatāṃ surarūpiṇīm
āsanena mahārheṇa śaṃpādayad aninditām
āsīnāṃ tām athovāca menā himavataḥ priyā //
38.d:
अथ दृष्ट्वा सतीं देवीम् आगतां सुररूपिणीम्
आसनेन महार्हेण शंपादयद् अनिन्दिताम्
आसीनां ताम् अथोवाच मेना हिमवतः प्रिया ॥
38.m: Then, seeing that virtuous goddess arrived, of divine form, / Menā, the beloved of the Himavat, provided the blameless lady / with an expensive seat and said to her as she sat:

38.s:
menovāca
cirasyāgamanaṃ te 'dya vada putri śubhekṣaṇe
daridrā krīḍanais tvaṃ hi bhartrā krīḍasi saṃgatā //
38.d:
मेनोवाच
चिरस्यागमनं ते ऽद्य वद पुत्रि शुभेक्षणे
दरिद्रा क्रीडनैस् त्वं हि भर्त्रा क्रीडसि संगता ॥
38.m:
Menā said:
Tell me, daughter of auspicious eyes, why have you come after so long? / Indeed, poor as you are, you play with toys, joined with your husband.

38.s:
ye daridrā bhavanti sma tathaiva ca nirāśrayāḥ
ume ta evaṃ krīḍanti yathā tava patiḥ śubhe //
38.d:
ये दरिद्रा भवन्ति स्म तथैव च निराश्रयाः
उमे त एवं क्रीडन्ति यथा तव पतिः शुभे ॥
38.m: Those who are poor and likewise shelterless, / O Umā, they play in such a manner, just as your husband does, O auspicious one.

38.s:
brahmovāca
saivam uktātha mātrā tu nātihṛṣṭamanā bhavat
mahatyā kṣamayā yuktā na kiṃcit tām uvāca ha
visṛṣṭā ca tadā mātrā gatvā devam uvāca ha //
38.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
सैवम् उक्ताथ मात्रा तु नातिहृष्टमना भवत्
महत्या क्षमया युक्ता न किंचित् ताम् उवाच ह
विसृष्टा च तदा मात्रा गत्वा देवम् उवाच ह ॥
38.m:
Brahmā said:
Being spoken to thus by her mother, she did not become very joyful in mind. / Endowed with great patience, she said nothing to her at all; / and dismissed then by her mother, she went and said to the god:

38.s:
pārvaty uvāca
bhagavan devadeveśa neha vatsyāmi bhūdhare
anyaṃ kuru mamāvāsaṃ bhuvaneṣu mahādyute //
38.d:
पार्वत्य् उवाच
भगवन् देवदेवेश नेह वत्स्यामि भूधरे
अन्यं कुरु ममावासं भुवनेषु महाद्युते ॥
38.m:
Pārvatī said:
O lord, lord of the god of gods, I will not dwell here on this mountain. / Make another dwelling for me among the worlds, O greatly radiant one!

38.s:
deva uvāca
sadā tvam ucyamānā vai mayā vāsārtham īśvari
anyaṃ na rocitavatī vāsaṃ vai devi karhicit //
38.d:
देव उवाच
सदा त्वम् उच्यमाना वै मया वासार्थम् ईश्वरि
अन्यं न रोचितवती वासं वै देवि कर्हिचित् ॥
38.m:
The god said:
Though you were always spoken to by me regarding a dwelling, O sovereign lady, / you never found any other dwelling pleasing, O goddess.

38.s:
idānīṃ svayam eva tvaṃ vāsam anyatra śobhane
kasmān mṛgayase devi brūhi tan me śucismite //
38.d:
इदानीं स्वयम् एव त्वं वासम् अन्यत्र शोभने
कस्मान् मृगयसे देवि ब्रूहि तन् मे शुचिस्मिते ॥
38.m: Why do you now yourself seek a dwelling elsewhere, / O fair lady? Tell me that, O goddess of pure smiles!

38.s:
devy uvāca
gṛhaṃ gatāsmi deveśa pitur adya mahātmanaḥ
dṛṣṭvā ca tatra me mātā vijane lokabhāvane //
38.d:
देव्य् उवाच
गृहं गतास्मि देवेश पितुर् अद्य महात्मनः
दृष्ट्वा च तत्र मे माता विजने लोकभावने ॥
38.m:
The goddess said:
O lord of gods, creator of the worlds, today I went to the house of my great-souled father; / and seeing me there in private, my mother,

38.s:
āsanādibhir abhyarcya sā mām evam abhāṣata
ume tava sadā bhartā daridraḥ krīḍanaiḥ śubhe //
38.d:
आसनादिभिर् अभ्यर्च्य सा माम् एवम् अभाषत
उमे तव सदा भर्ता दरिद्रः क्रीडनैः शुभे ॥
38.m: having honored me with a seat and other offerings, spoke to me thus: / 'O Umā, your husband is always poor, playing with toys, O auspicious one;

38.s:
krīḍate nahi devānāṃ krīḍā bhavati tādṛśī
yat kila tvaṃ mahādeva gaṇaiś ca vividhais tathā
ramase tad aniṣṭaṃ hi mama mātur vṛṣadhvaja //
38.d:
क्रीडते नहि देवानां क्रीडा भवति तादृशी
यत् किल त्वं महादेव गणैश् च विविधैस् तथा
रमसे तद् अनिष्टं हि मम मातुर् वृषध्वज ॥
38.m: he plays, for such is not the play of the gods.' / Inasmuch as you, O Mahādeva, sport thus with various attendants, / that, O bull-bannered one, is indeed distasteful to my mother.

38.s:
brahmovāca
tato devaḥ prahasyāha devīṃ hāsayituṃ prabhuḥ //
38.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततो देवः प्रहस्याह देवीं हासयितुं प्रभुः ॥
38.m:
Brahmā said:
Then the lord, laughing, said to the goddess to make her laugh:

38.s:
deva uvāca
evam eva na saṃdehaḥ kasmān manyur abhūt tava
kṛttivāsā hy avāsāś ca śmaśānanilayaś ca ha //
38.d:
देव उवाच
एवम् एव न संदेहः कस्मान् मन्युर् अभूत् तव
कृत्तिवासा ह्य् अवासाश् च श्मशाननिलयश् च ह ॥
38.m:
The god said:
It is just so, there is no doubt; why has anger arisen in you? / For I am clad in an animal skin, without garments, and my abode is the cremation ground;

38.s:
aniketo hy araṇyeṣu parvatānāṃ guhāsu ca
vicarāmi gaṇair nagnair vṛto 'mbhojavilocane //
38.d:
अनिकेतो ह्य् अरण्येषु पर्वतानां गुहासु च
विचरामि गणैर् नग्नैर् वृतो ऽम्भोजविलोचने ॥
38.m: homeless indeed, in forests and in mountain caves / I wander, surrounded by naked attendants, O lotus-eyed lady.

38.s:
mā krudho devi mātre tvaṃ tathyaṃ mātāvadat tava
nahi mātṛsamo bandhur jantūnām asti bhūtale //
38.d:
मा क्रुधो देवि मात्रे त्वं तथ्यं मातावदत् तव
नहि मातृसमो बन्धुर् जन्तूनाम् अस्ति भूतले ॥
38.m: Do not be angry with your mother, O goddess; your mother spoke the truth. / For there is no relative equal to a mother for living creatures on the surface of the earth.

38.s:
devy uvāca
na me 'sti bandhubhiḥ kiṃcit kṛtyaṃ suravareśvara
tathā kuru mahādeva yathāhaṃ sukham āpnuyām //
38.d:
देव्य् उवाच
न मे ऽस्ति बन्धुभिः किंचित् कृत्यं सुरवरेश्वर
तथा कुरु महादेव यथाहं सुखम् आप्नुयाम् ॥
38.m:
The goddess said:
I have nothing to do with relatives, O lord of the foremost gods! / Act in such a way, O Mahādeva, that I may find happiness.

38.s:
brahmovāca
śrutvā sa devyā vacanaṃ sureśas
tasyāḥ priyārthe svagiriṃ vihāya
jagāma meruṃ surasiddhasevitaṃ
bhāryāsahāyaḥ svagaṇaiś ca yuktaḥ
38.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
श्रुत्वा स देव्या वचनं सुरेशस्
तस्याः प्रियार्थे स्वगिरिं विहाय
जगाम मेरुं सुरसिद्धसेवितं
भार्यासहायः स्वगणैश् च युक्तः
38.m:
Brahmā said:
Having heard the goddess's word, the lord of gods, / to please her, abandoned his own mountain / and went to Meru, frequented by gods and siddhas, / accompanied by his wife and joined by his own attendants.

39.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
prācetasasya dakṣasya kathaṃ vaivasvate 'ntare
vināśam agamad brahman hayamedhaḥ prajāpateḥ //
39.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः
प्राचेतसस्य दक्षस्य कथं वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे
विनाशम् अगमद् ब्रह्मन् हयमेधः प्रजापतेः ॥
39.m:
The sages said:
How did the horse-sacrifice of Dakṣa, son of Pracetas, / the lord of creatures, meet with destruction during the Vaivasvata interval, O Brahmā?

39.s:
devyā manyukṛtaṃ buddhvā kruddhaḥ sarvātmakaḥ prabhuḥ
kathaṃ vināśito yajño dakṣasyāmitatejasaḥ
mahādevena roṣād vai tan naḥ prabrūhi vistarāt //
39.d:
देव्या मन्युकृतं बुद्ध्वा क्रुद्धः सर्वात्मकः प्रभुः
कथं विनाशितो यज्ञो दक्षस्यामिततेजसः
महादेवेन रोषाद् वै तन् नः प्रब्रूहि विस्तरात् ॥
39.m: Knowing that [the destruction] was brought about by the goddess's resentment, how was the sacrifice / of Dakṣa of immeasurable splendor destroyed in anger by Mahādeva, the all-pervading lord? / Tell us that in detail!

39.s:
brahmovāca
varṇayiṣyāmi vo viprā mahādevena vai yathā
krodhād vidhvaṃsito yajño devyāḥ priyacikīrṣayā //
39.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
वर्णयिष्यामि वो विप्रा महादेवेन वै यथा
क्रोधाद् विध्वंसितो यज्ञो देव्याः प्रियचिकीर्षया ॥
39.m:
Brahmā said:
I will describe to you, O brahmins, how indeed the sacrifice / was destroyed in anger by Mahādeva out of a desire to please the goddess.

39.s:
purā meror dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ śṛṅgaṃ trailokyapūjitam
jyotiḥsthalaṃ nāma citraṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam //
39.d:
पुरा मेरोर् द्विजश्रेष्ठाः शृङ्गं त्रैलोक्यपूजितम्
ज्योतिःस्थलं नाम चित्रं सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् ॥
39.m: Formerly, O best among the twice-born, on a peak of Meru worshipped by the three worlds, / known as Jyotiḥsthala, wondrous, adorned with all jewels,

39.s:
aprameyam anādhṛṣyaṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam
tatra devo giritaṭe sarvadhātuvicitrite //
39.d:
अप्रमेयम् अनाधृष्यं सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम्
तत्र देवो गिरितटे सर्वधातुविचित्रिते ॥
39.m: immeasurable, unassailable, venerated by all the worlds, / there on the mountain slope variegated with all minerals,

39.s:
paryaṅka iva vistīrṇa upaviṣṭo babhūva ha
śailarājasutā cāsya nityaṃ pārśvasthitābhavat //
39.d:
पर्यङ्क इव विस्तीर्ण उपविष्टो बभूव ह
शैलराजसुता चास्य नित्यं पार्श्वस्थिताभवत् ॥
39.m: the god sat as if upon an expansive couch, / and the daughter of the mountain king was ever by his side.

39.s:
ādityāś ca mahātmāno vasavaś ca mahaujasaḥ
tathaiva ca mahātmānāv aśvinau bhiṣajāṃ varau //
39.d:
आदित्याश् च महात्मानो वसवश् च महौजसः
तथैव च महात्मानाव् अश्विनौ भिषजां वरौ ॥
39.m: The great-souled Ādityas, the Vasus of mighty energy, / and likewise the great-souled Aśvins, best of physicians,

39.s:
tathā vaiśravaṇo rājā guhyakaiḥ parivāritaḥ
yakṣāṇām īśvaraḥ śrīmān kailāsanilayaḥ prabhuḥ //
39.d:
तथा वैश्रवणो राजा गुह्यकैः परिवारितः
यक्षाणाम् ईश्वरः श्रीमान् कैलासनिलयः प्रभुः ॥
39.m: So too King Vaiśravaṇa, surrounded by Guhyakas, / the glorious lord of Yakṣas, the master residing on Kailāsa;

39.s:
upāsate mahātmānam uśanā ca mahāmuniḥ
sanatkumārapramukhās tathaiva paramarṣayaḥ //
39.d:
उपासते महात्मानम् उशना च महामुनिः
सनत्कुमारप्रमुखास् तथैव परमर्षयः ॥
39.m: the great sage Uśanas attended upon the great-souled one, / and likewise the supreme sages headed by Sanatkumāra;

39.s:
aṅgiraḥpramukhāś caiva tathā devarṣayo 'pi ca
viśvāvasuś ca gandharvas tathā nāradaparvatau //
39.d:
अङ्गिरःप्रमुखाश् चैव तथा देवर्षयो ऽपि च
विश्वावसुश् च गन्धर्वस् तथा नारदपर्वतौ ॥
39.m: and the divine sages headed by Aṅgiras as well; / and the gandharva Viśvāvasu, and Nārada and Parvata;

39.s:
apsarogaṇasaṃghāś ca samājagmur anekaśaḥ
vavau sukhaśivo vāyur nānāgandhavahaḥ śuciḥ //
39.d:
अप्सरोगणसंघाश् च समाजग्मुर् अनेकशः
ववौ सुखशिवो वायुर् नानागन्धवहः शुचिः ॥
39.m: and troops of apsarases arrived in large numbers. / A pleasant and auspicious wind blew, fragrant and pure;

39.s:
sarvartukusumopetaḥ puṣpavanto 'bhavan drumāḥ
tathā vidyādharāḥ sādhyāḥ siddhāś caiva tapodhanāḥ //
39.d:
सर्वर्तुकुसुमोपेतः पुष्पवन्तो ऽभवन् द्रुमाः
तथा विद्याधराः साध्याः सिद्धाश् चैव तपोधनाः ॥
39.m: the trees bore blossoms, endowed with flowers of every season; / likewise the vidyādharas, sādhyas, and siddhas rich in ascetic power,

39.s:
mahādevaṃ paśupatiṃ paryupāsata tatra vai
bhūtāni ca tathānyāni nānārūpadharāṇy atha //
39.d:
महादेवं पशुपतिं पर्युपासत तत्र वै
भूतानि च तथान्यानि नानारूपधराण्य् अथ ॥
39.m: attended there upon Mahādeva, the lord of beasts; / and then other creatures assuming various forms;

39.s:
rākṣasāś ca mahāraudrāḥ piśācāś ca mahābalāḥ
bahurūpadharā dhṛṣṭā nānāpraharaṇāyudhāḥ //
39.d:
राक्षसाश् च महारौद्राः पिशाचाश् च महाबलाः
बहुरूपधरा धृष्टा नानाप्रहरणायुधाः ॥
39.m: terrible rākṣasas and mighty piśācas, / assuming multiform shapes, bold, armed with diverse weapons;

39.s:
devasyānucarās tatra tasthur vaiśvānaropamāḥ
nandīśvaraś ca bhagavān devasyānumate sthitaḥ //
39.d:
देवस्यानुचरास् तत्र तस्थुर् वैश्वानरोपमाः
नन्दीश्वरश् च भगवान् देवस्यानुमते स्थितः ॥
39.m: attendants of the god, resembling blazing fire, stood there; / and the venerable Nandīśvara stood by the command of the god,

39.s:
pragṛhya jvalitaṃ śūlaṃ dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā
gaṅgā ca saritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvatīrthajalodbhavā //
39.d:
प्रगृह्य ज्वलितं शूलं दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा
गङ्गा च सरितां श्रेष्ठा सर्वतीर्थजलोद्भवा ॥
39.m: holding a flaming trident that blazed with its own radiance; / and the Gaṅgā, the foremost of rivers, source of the waters of all holy sites,

39.s:
paryupāsata taṃ devaṃ rūpiṇī dvijasattamāḥ
evaṃ sa bhagavāṃs tatra pūjyamānaḥ surarṣibhiḥ //
39.d:
पर्युपासत तं देवं रूपिणी द्विजसत्तमाः
एवं स भगवांस् तत्र पूज्यमानः सुरर्षिभिः ॥
39.m: attended upon that god in embodied form, O best of the twice-born. / Thus that blessed lord, being worshipped there by the divine sages

39.s:
devaiś ca sumahābhāgair mahādevo vyatiṣṭhata
kasyacit tv atha kālasya dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ //
39.d:
देवैश् च सुमहाभागैर् महादेवो व्यतिष्ठत
कस्यचित् त्व् अथ कालस्य दक्षो नाम प्रजापतिः ॥
39.m: and by the most fortunate gods, Mahādeva remained. / Then, after some time, the prajāpati named Dakṣa

39.s:
pūrvoktena vidhānena yakṣyamāṇo 'bhyapadyata
tatas tasya makhe devāḥ sarve śakrapurogamāḥ //
39.d:
पूर्वोक्तेन विधानेन यक्ष्यमाणो ऽभ्यपद्यत
ततस् तस्य मखे देवाः सर्वे शक्रपुरोगमाः ॥
39.m: undertook to perform a sacrifice according to the previously stated rite. / Then all the gods, led by Śakra, to his sacrifice,

39.s:
svargasthānād athāgamya dakṣam āpedire tathā
te vimānair mahātmāno jvaladbhir jvalanaprabhāḥ //
39.d:
स्वर्गस्थानाद् अथागम्य दक्षम् आपेदिरे तथा
ते विमानैर् महात्मानो ज्वलद्भिर् ज्वलनप्रभाः ॥
39.m: having arrived from the abode of heaven, approached Dakṣa. / Those great-souled ones, radiant as blazing fire, in shining aerial chariots,

39.s:
devasyānumate 'gacchan gaṅgādvāram iti śrutiḥ
gandharvāpsarasākīrṇaṃ nānādrumalatāvṛtam //
39.d:
देवस्यानुमते ऽगच्छन् गङ्गाद्वारम् इति श्रुतिः
गन्धर्वाप्सरसाकीर्णं नानाद्रुमलतावृतम् ॥
39.m: went by the god’s command to Gaṅgādvāra, so it is heard, / which was crowded with gandharvas and apsarases, and filled with various trees and creepers.

39.s:
ṛṣisiddhaiḥ parivṛtaṃ dakṣaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varam
pṛthivyām antarikṣe ca ye ca svarlokavāsinaḥ //
39.d:
ऋषिसिद्धैः परिवृतं दक्षं धर्मभृतां वरम्
पृथिव्याम् अन्तरिक्षे च ये च स्वर्लोकवासिनः ॥
39.m: [They approached] Dakṣa, the best of the upholders of dharma, surrounded by sages and siddhas. / Those on earth and in the intermediate space, and those who dwell in the celestial world,

39.s:
sarve prāñjalayo bhūtvā upatasthuḥ prajāpatim
ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyāḥ sarve marudgaṇāḥ //
39.d:
सर्वे प्राञ्जलयो भूत्वा उपतस्थुः प्रजापतिम्
आदित्या वसवो रुद्राः साध्याः सर्वे मरुद्गणाः ॥
39.m: all joined their hands in reverence and approached the prajāpati: / the ādityas, vasus, rudras, sādhyas, and all the host of maruts,

39.s:
viṣṇunā sahitāḥ sarva āgatā yajñabhāginaḥ
ūṣmapā dhūmapāś caiva ājyapāḥ somapās tathā //
39.d:
विष्णुना सहिताः सर्व आगता यज्ञभागिनः
ऊष्मपा धूमपाश् चैव आज्यपाः सोमपास् तथा ॥
39.m: all gathered together with Viṣṇu to receive their share of the sacrifice; / the Ūṣmapas and Dhūmapas, the Ājyapas and the Somapas,

39.s:
aśvinau marutaś caiva nānādevagaṇaiḥ saha
ete cānye ca bahavo bhūtagrāmās tathaiva ca //
39.d:
अश्विनौ मरुतश् चैव नानादेवगणैः सह
एते चान्ये च बहवो भूतग्रामास् तथैव च ॥
39.m: the Aśvins and the maruts along with various hosts of gods; / these and many other multitudes of living beings;

39.s:
jarāyujāṇḍajāś caiva tathaiva svedajodbhidaḥ
āgatāḥ sattriṇaḥ sarve devāḥ strībhiḥ saharṣibhiḥ //
39.d:
जरायुजाण्डजाश् चैव तथैव स्वेदजोद्भिदः
आगताः सत्त्रिणः सर्वे देवाः स्त्रीभिः सहर्षिभिः ॥
39.m: the womb-born and the egg-born, and likewise the sweat-born and the sprout-born. / All the sacrificers arrived, the gods along with their wives and with sages.

39.s:
virājante vimānasthā dīpyamānā ivāgnayaḥ
tān dṛṣṭvā manyunāviṣṭo dadhīcir vākyam abravīt //
39.d:
विराजन्ते विमानस्था दीप्यमाना इवाग्नयः
तान् दृष्ट्वा मन्युनाविष्टो दधीचिर् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥
39.m: Seated in their aerial chariots, they shone like blazing fires. / Seeing them, Dadhīca, filled with anger, spoke these words:

39.s:
dadhīcir uvāca
apūjyapūjane caiva pūjyānāṃ cāpy apūjane
naraḥ pāpam avāpnoti mahad vai nātra saṃśayaḥ //
39.d:
दधीचिर् उवाच
अपूज्यपूजने चैव पूज्यानां चाप्य् अपूजने
नरः पापम् अवाप्नोति महद् वै नात्र संशयः ॥
39.m: Dadhīca said: / In worshipping what should not be worshipped, and in not worshipping the venerable, / a person incurs great sin indeed; there is no doubt of this.

39.s:
brahmovāca
evam uktvā tu viprarṣiḥ punar dakṣam abhāṣata //
39.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
एवम् उक्त्वा तु विप्रर्षिः पुनर् दक्षम् अभाषत ॥
39.m: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus, the brahmarṣi addressed Dakṣa again:

39.s:
dadhīcir uvāca
pūjyaṃ ca paśubhartāraṃ kasmān nārcayase prabhum //
39.d:
दधीचिर् उवाच
पूज्यं च पशुभर्तारं कस्मान् नार्चयसे प्रभुम् ॥
39.m: Dadhīca said: / Why do you not worship the master, the venerable protector of creatures?

39.s:
dakṣa uvāca
santi me bahavo rudrāḥ śūlahastāḥ kapardinaḥ
ekādaśasthānagatā nānyaṃ vidmo maheśvaram //
39.d:
दक्ष उवाच
सन्ति मे बहवो रुद्राः शूलहस्ताः कपर्दिनः
एकादशस्थानगता नान्यं विद्मो महेश्वरम् ॥
39.m: Dakṣa said: / There are many rudras for me, trident-bearers with matted hair, / assigned to eleven places; we know no other supreme lord.

39.s:
dadhīcir uvāca
sarveṣām ekamantro 'yaṃ mameśo na nimantritaḥ
yathāhaṃ śaṃkarād ūrdhvaṃ nānyaṃ paśyāmi daivatam
tathā dakṣasya vipulo yajño 'yaṃ na bhaviṣyati //
39.d:
दधीचिर् उवाच
सर्वेषाम् एकमन्त्रो ऽयं ममेशो न निमन्त्रितः
यथाहं शंकराद् ऊर्ध्वं नान्यं पश्यामि दैवतम्
तथा दक्षस्य विपुलो यज्ञो ऽयं न भविष्यति ॥
39.m: Dadhīca said: / This single formula is for all; my Lord has not been invited. / Just as I see no deity higher than Śaṅkara, / so shall this vast sacrifice of Dakṣa not succeed.

39.s:
dakṣa uvāca dakṣa uvāca
viṣṇoś ca bhāgā vividhāḥ pradattās
tathā ca rudrebhya uta pradattāḥ
anye 'pi devā nijabhāgayuktā
dadāmi bhāgaṃ na tu śaṃkarāya
39.d:
दक्ष उवाच दक्ष उवाच
विष्णोश् च भागा विविधाः प्रदत्तास्
तथा च रुद्रेभ्य उत प्रदत्ताः
अन्ये ऽपि देवा निजभागयुक्ता
ददामि भागं न तु शंकराय
39.m: Dakṣa said: / Diverse shares have been given to Viṣṇu, / and shares have likewise been given to the rudras; / other gods also are provided with their respective shares; / but to Śaṅkara I give no share.

39.s:
brahmovāca
gatās tu devatā jñātvā śailarājasutā tadā
uvāca vacanaṃ śarvaṃ devaṃ paśupatiṃ patim //
39.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
गतास् तु देवता ज्ञात्वा शैलराजसुता तदा
उवाच वचनं शर्वं देवं पशुपतिं पतिम् ॥
39.m: Brahmā said: / Knowing that the deities had gone, the daughter of the mountain king then / spoke these words to Śarva, the god, the lord of creatures, her husband:

39.s:
umovāca
bhagavan kutra yānty ete devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ
brūhi tattvena tattvajña saṃśayo me mahān ayam //
39.d:
उमोवाच
भगवन् कुत्र यान्त्य् एते देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः
ब्रूहि तत्त्वेन तत्त्वज्ञ संशयो मे महान् अयम् ॥
39.m: Umā said: / O Blessed One, where are these gods led by Śakra going? / Tell me truly, O knower of reality; this is a great doubt of mine.

39.s:
maheśvara uvāca
dakṣo nāma mahābhāge prajānāṃ patir uttamaḥ
hayamedhena yajate tatra yānti divaukasaḥ //
39.d:
महेश्वर उवाच
दक्षो नाम महाभागे प्रजानां पतिर् उत्तमः
हयमेधेन यजते तत्र यान्ति दिवौकसः ॥
39.m: Maheśvara said: / O most fortunate lady, the highest lord of creatures named Dakṣa / is performing a horse sacrifice; the dwellers of heaven are going there.

39.s:
devy uvāca
yajñam etaṃ mahābhāga kimarthaṃ nānugacchasi
kena vā pratiṣedhena gamanaṃ te na vidyate //
39.d:
देव्य् उवाच
यज्ञम् एतं महाभाग किमर्थं नानुगच्छसि
केन वा प्रतिषेधेन गमनं ते न विद्यते ॥
39.m: The goddess said: / O most fortunate one, why do you not attend this sacrifice? / Or by what exclusion is your going forbidden?

39.s:
maheśvara uvāca
surair eva mahābhāge sarvam etad anuṣṭhitam
yajñeṣu mama sarveṣu na bhāga upakalpitaḥ //
39.d:
महेश्वर उवाच
सुरैर् एव महाभागे सर्वम् एतद् अनुष्ठितम्
यज्ञेषु मम सर्वेषु न भाग उपकल्पितः ॥
39.m: Maheśvara said: / All this has been established by the gods themselves, O most fortunate lady; / in all sacrifices, no share has been allotted to me.

39.s:
pūrvāgatena gantavyaṃ mārgeṇa varavarṇini
na me surāḥ prayacchanti bhāgaṃ yajñasya dharmataḥ //
39.d:
पूर्वागतेन गन्तव्यं मार्गेण वरवर्णिनि
न मे सुराः प्रयच्छन्ति भागं यज्ञस्य धर्मतः ॥
39.m: One must go by the path established of old, O fair-complexioned lady; / the gods do not grant me a share of the sacrifice according to dharma.

39.s:
umovāca
bhagavan sarvadeveṣu prabhāvābhyadhiko guṇaiḥ
ajeyaś cāpy adhṛṣyaś ca tejasā yaśasā śriyā //
39.d:
उमोवाच
भगवन् सर्वदेवेषु प्रभावाभ्यधिको गुणैः
अजेयश् चाप्य् अधृष्यश् च तेजसा यशसा श्रिया ॥
39.m: Umā said: / O Blessed One, you surpass all gods in power and virtues; / you are unconquerable and unassailable in splendor, fame, and majesty.

39.s:
anena tu mahābhāga pratiṣedhena bhāgataḥ
atīva duḥkham āpannā vepathuś ca mahān ayam //
39.d:
अनेन तु महाभाग प्रतिषेधेन भागतः
अतीव दुःखम् आपन्ना वेपथुश् च महान् अयम् ॥
39.m: Yet by this exclusion from the sacrificial share, O most fortunate one, / I have fallen into extreme grief, and this great trembling [has seized me].

39.s:
kiṃ nāma dānaṃ niyamaṃ tapo vā
kuryām ahaṃ yena patir mamādya
labheta bhāgaṃ bhagavān acintyo
yajñasya cendrādyamarair vicitram
39.d:
किं नाम दानं नियमं तपो वा
कुर्याम् अहं येन पतिर् ममाद्य
लभेत भागं भगवान् अचिन्त्यो
यज्ञस्य चेन्द्राद्यमरैर् विचित्रम्
39.m: What gift, vow, or ascetic discipline / could I perform today so that my husband, / the blessed, inconceivable lord, may obtain / a splendid share of the sacrifice along with the immortals headed by Indra?

39.s:
brahmovāca maheśvara uvāca
ahaṃ vijānāmi viśālanetre
dhyānena sarve ca vidanti santaḥ
tavādya mohena sahendradevā
lokatrayaṃ sarvam atho vinaṣṭam
39.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच महेश्वर उवाच
अहं विजानामि विशालनेत्रे
ध्यानेन सर्वे च विदन्ति सन्तः
तवाद्य मोहेन सहेन्द्रदेवा
लोकत्रयं सर्वम् अथो विनष्टम्
39.m:
I know, O wide-eyed lady;
and all virtuous people know through meditation.
Now, through your delusion, together with the gods led by Indra,
the entire triple world is destroyed.

39.s:
mām adhvareśaṃ nitarāṃ stuvanti
rathaṃtaraṃ sāma gāyanti mahyam
māṃ brāhmaṇā brahmamantrair yajanti
mamādhvaryavaḥ kalpayante ca bhāgam
39.d:
माम् अध्वरेशं नितरां स्तुवन्ति
रथंतरं साम गायन्ति मह्यम्
मां ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्ममन्त्रैर् यजन्ति
ममाध्वर्यवः कल्पयन्ते च भागम्
39.m: They praise me above all as the lord of the sacrifice; / they sing the Rathaṃtara Sāman for me; / the brahmins sacrifice to me with the sacred formulas of Brahmā; / and the Adhvaryu priests assign a share to me.

39.s:
devy uvāca
vikatthase prākṛtavat sarvastrījanasaṃsadi
stauṣi garvāyase cāpi svam ātmānaṃ na saṃśayaḥ //
39.d:
देव्य् उवाच
विकत्थसे प्राकृतवत् सर्वस्त्रीजनसंसदि
स्तौषि गर्वायसे चापि स्वम् आत्मानं न संशयः ॥
39.m: The goddess said: / You boast like an ordinary man in an assembly of women; / you praise and take pride in yourself, there is no doubt.

39.s:
bhagavān uvāca
nātmānaṃ staumi deveśi yathā tvam anugacchasi
saṃsrakṣyāmi varārohe bhāgārthe varavarṇini //
39.d:
भगवान् उवाच
नात्मानं स्तौमि देवेशि यथा त्वम् अनुगच्छसि
संस्रक्ष्यामि वरारोहे भागार्थे वरवर्णिनि ॥
39.m: The Blessed Lord said: / I do not praise myself, O goddess of gods, as you assume; / I shall create [a being], O fair-hipped, fair-complexioned lady, for the sake of the share.

39.s:
brahmovāca
ity uktvā bhagavān patnīm umāṃ prāṇair api priyām
so 'sṛjad bhagavān vaktrād bhūtaṃ krodhāgnisaṃbhavam //
39.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
इत्य् उक्त्वा भगवान् पत्नीम् उमां प्राणैर् अपि प्रियाम्
सो ऽसृजद् भगवान् वक्त्राद् भूतं क्रोधाग्निसंभवम् ॥
39.m: Brahmā said: / Having spoken thus to his wife Umā, who was dearer to him than his own life-breaths, / the Blessed Lord brought forth from his mouth a being born from the fire of wrath.

39.s:
tam uvāca makhaṃ gaccha dakṣasya tvaṃ maheśvaraḥ
nāśayāśu kratuṃ tasya dakṣasya madanujñayā //
39.d:
तम् उवाच मखं गच्छ दक्षस्य त्वं महेश्वरः
नाशयाशु क्रतुं तस्य दक्षस्य मदनुज्ञया ॥
39.m: He, the supreme lord, said to him: 'Go to Dakṣa's sacrifice; / destroy quickly that sacrifice of Dakṣa by my command.'

39.s:
brahmovāca
tato rudraprayuktena siṃhaveṣeṇa līlayā
devyā manyukṛtaṃ jñātvā hato dakṣasya sa kratuḥ //
39.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
ततो रुद्रप्रयुक्तेन सिंहवेषेण लीलया
देव्या मन्युकृतं ज्ञात्वा हतो दक्षस्य स क्रतुः ॥
39.m: Brahmā said: / Then, by that [being] dispatched by Rudra, in the guise of a lion, as if in sport, / knowing it was done out of the goddess's anger, that sacrifice of Dakṣa was destroyed.

39.s:
manyunā ca mahābhīmā bhadrakālī maheśvarī
ātmanaḥ karmasākṣitve tena sārdhaṃ sahānugā //
39.d:
मन्युना च महाभीमा भद्रकाली महेश्वरी
आत्मनः कर्मसाक्षित्वे तेन सार्धं सहानुगा ॥
39.m: And from anger, the exceedingly dreadful Bhadrakālī, the supreme goddess, / went along with him together with her followers, to bear witness to her own deed.

39.s:
sa eṣa bhagavān krodhaḥ pretāvāsakṛtālayaḥ
vīrabhadreti vikhyāto devyā manyupramārjakaḥ //
39.d:
स एष भगवान् क्रोधः प्रेतावासकृतालयः
वीरभद्रेति विख्यातो देव्या मन्युप्रमार्जकः ॥
39.m: This very Lord of Wrath, whose abode was made in the dwelling-place of the spirits, / known as Vīrabhadra, was the dispeller of the goddess's anger.

39.s:
so 'sṛjad romakūpebhya ātmanaiva gaṇeśvarān
rudrānugān gaṇān raudrān rudravīryaparākramān //
39.d:
सो ऽसृजद् रोमकूपेभ्य आत्मनैव गणेश्वरान्
रुद्रानुगान् गणान् रौद्रान् रुद्रवीर्यपराक्रमान् ॥
39.m: From his own hair-pores he created leaders of the troops: / fearsome hosts, followers of Rudra, having the power and prowess of Rudra.

39.s:
rudrasyānucarāḥ sarve sarve rudraparākramāḥ
te nipetus tatas tūrṇaṃ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ //
39.d:
रुद्रस्यानुचराः सर्वे सर्वे रुद्रपराक्रमाः
ते निपेतुस् ततस् तूर्णं शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः ॥
39.m: All the attendants of Rudra, every one of them having the prowess of Rudra, / then swooped down swiftly by the hundreds and by the thousands.

39.s:
tataḥ kilakilāśabda ākāśaṃ pūrayann iva
samabhūt sumahān viprāḥ sarvarudragaṇaiḥ kṛtaḥ //
39.d:
ततः किलकिलाशब्द आकाशं पूरयन्न् इव
समभूत् सुमहान् विप्राः सर्वरुद्रगणैः कृतः ॥
39.m: Then a tumultuous roar, as if filling the sky, / arose, O Brahmins, raised by all the hosts of Rudra.

39.s:
tena śabdena mahatā trastāḥ sarve divaukasaḥ
parvatāś ca vyaśīryanta cakampe ca vasuṃdharā //
39.d:
तेन शब्देन महता त्रस्ताः सर्वे दिवौकसः
पर्वताश् च व्यशीर्यन्त चकम्पे च वसुंधरा ॥
39.m: Frightened by that great roar, all the sky-dwellers trembled; / mountains crumbled, and the earth shook.

39.s:
marutaś ca vavuḥ krūrāś cukṣubhe varuṇālayaḥ
agnayo vai na dīpyante na cādīpyata bhāskaraḥ //
39.d:
मरुतश् च ववुः क्रूराश् चुक्षुभे वरुणालयः
अग्नयो वै न दीप्यन्ते न चादीप्यत भास्करः ॥
39.m: Fierce winds blew, and the abode of Varuṇa was agitated; / the fires indeed did not burn, nor did the sun shine.

39.s:
grahā naiva prakāśante nakṣatrāṇi na tārakāḥ
ṛṣayo na prabhāsante na devā na ca dānavāḥ //
39.d:
ग्रहा नैव प्रकाशन्ते नक्षत्राणि न तारकाः
ऋषयो न प्रभासन्ते न देवा न च दानवाः ॥
39.m: The planets did not shine at all, nor the constellations, nor the stars; / the ṛṣis did not radiant shine, nor the gods, nor the Dānavas.

39.s:
evaṃ hi timirībhūte nirdahanti gaṇeśvarāḥ
prabhañjanty apare yūpān ghorān utpāṭayanti ca //
39.d:
एवं हि तिमिरीभूते निर्दहन्ति गणेश्वराः
प्रभञ्जन्त्य् अपरे यूपान् घोरान् उत्पाटयन्ति च ॥
39.m: When darkness had thus fallen, the lords of the gaṇas burned everything down; / others shattered the sacrificial posts and uprooted the terrifying ones.

39.s:
praṇadanti tathā cānye vikurvanti tathā pare
tvaritaṃ vai pradhāvanti vāyuvegā manojavāḥ //
39.d:
प्रणदन्ति तथा चान्ये विकुर्वन्ति तथा परे
त्वरितं वै प्रधावन्ति वायुवेगा मनोजवाः ॥
39.m: And others roared loudly; still others assumed strange forms; / swift as the wind and swift as thought, they rushed forward at full speed.

39.s:
cūrṇyante yajñapātrāṇi yajñasyāyatanāni ca
śīryamāṇāny adṛśyanta tārā iva nabhastalāt //
39.d:
चूर्ण्यन्ते यज्ञपात्राणि यज्ञस्यायतनानि च
शीर्यमाणान्य् अदृश्यन्त तारा इव नभस्तलात् ॥
39.m: The sacrificial vessels and the shrines of the sacrifice were crushed; / being shattered, they were seen falling like stars from the vault of heaven.

39.s:
divyānnapānabhakṣyāṇāṃ rāśayaḥ parvatopamāḥ
kṣīranadyas tathā cānyā ghṛtapāyasakardamāḥ //
39.d:
दिव्यान्नपानभक्ष्याणां राशयः पर्वतोपमाः
क्षीरनद्यस् तथा चान्या घृतपायसकर्दमाः ॥
39.m: There were heaps of divine foods, drinks, and edibles resembling mountains; / and other rivers of milk with mud of ghee and milk-rice pudding;

39.s:
madhumaṇḍodakā divyāḥ khaṇḍaśarkaravālukāḥ
ṣaḍrasān nivahanty anyā guḍakulyā manoramāḥ //
39.d:
मधुमण्डोदका दिव्याः खण्डशर्करवालुकाः
षड्रसान् निवहन्त्य् अन्या गुडकुल्या मनोरमाः ॥
39.m: divine waters of honey-scum, with sands of granulated sugar; / and other delightful streams of jaggery, carrying along the six flavors.

39.s:
uccāvacāni māṃsāni bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca
yāni kāni ca divyāni lehyacoṣyāṇi yāni ca //
39.d:
उच्चावचानि मांसानि भक्ष्याणि विविधानि च
यानि कानि च दिव्यानि लेह्यचोष्याणि यानि च ॥
39.m: Meats of all sorts, various kinds of foods, / whatever was divine, both licked and sucked—

39.s:
bhuñjanti vividhair vaktrair vilumpanti kṣipanti ca
rudrakopā mahākopāḥ kālāgnisadṛśopamāḥ //
39.d:
भुञ्जन्ति विविधैर् वक्त्रैर् विलुम्पन्ति क्षिपन्ति च
रुद्रकोपा महाकोपाः कालाग्निसदृशोपमाः ॥
39.m: they devoured with various mouths, plundered, and flung about, / those [attendants] born of Rudra’s wrath, highly enraged, resembling the fire of cosmic dissolution.

39.s:
bhakṣayanto 'tha śailābhā bhīṣayantaś ca sarvataḥ
krīḍanti vividhākārāś cikṣipuḥ surayoṣitaḥ //
39.d:
भक्षयन्तो ऽथ शैलाभा भीषयन्तश् च सर्वतः
क्रीडन्ति विविधाकाराश् चिक्षिपुः सुरयोषितः ॥
39.m: Devouring, mountain-like, terrifying [everyone] on all sides, / assuming diverse forms, they sported and tossed about the women of the gods.

39.s:
evaṃ gaṇāś ca tair yukto vīrabhadraḥ pratāpavān
rudrakopaprayuktaś ca sarvadevaiḥ surakṣitam //
39.d:
एवं गणाश् च तैर् युक्तो वीरभद्रः प्रतापवान्
रुद्रकोपप्रयुक्तश् च सर्वदेवैः सुरक्षितम् ॥
39.m: Thus the hosts, and accompanied by them the valorous Vīrabhadra, / dispatched by the wrath of Rudra, [attacked] that sacrifice well protected by all the gods.

39.s:
taṃ yajñam adahac chīghraṃ bhadrakālyāḥ samīpataḥ
cakrur anye tathā nādān sarvabhūtabhayaṃkarān //
39.d:
तं यज्ञम् अदहच् छीघ्रं भद्रकाल्याः समीपतः
चक्रुर् अन्ये तथा नादान् सर्वभूतभयंकरान् ॥
39.m: Quickly he burned that sacrifice near Bhadrakālī; / others likewise raised roars terrifying to all beings.

39.s:
chittvā śiro 'nye yajñasya vyanadanta bhayaṃkaram
tataḥ śakrādayo devā dakṣaś caiva prajāpatiḥ
ūcuḥ prāñjalayo bhūtvā kathyatāṃ ko bhavān iti //
39.d:
छित्त्वा शिरो ऽन्ये यज्ञस्य व्यनदन्त भयंकरम्
ततः शक्रादयो देवा दक्षश् चैव प्रजापतिः
ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयो भूत्वा कथ्यतां को भवान् इति ॥
39.m: Cutting off the head of the Sacrifice, others roared frightfully. / Then the gods headed by Śakra, and Dakṣa the lord of creatures, / joining their hands in reverence, said: “Tell us, who are you?”

39.s:
vīrabhadra uvāca
nāhaṃ devo na daityo vā na ca bhoktum ihāgataḥ
naiva draṣṭuṃ ca devendrā na ca kautūhalānvitāḥ //
39.d:
वीरभद्र उवाच
नाहं देवो न दैत्यो वा न च भोक्तुम् इहागतः
नैव द्रष्टुं च देवेन्द्रा न च कौतूहलान्विताः ॥
39.m: Vīrabhadra said: / “I am neither a god nor a Daitya, nor have I come here to eat, / nor to see, O lords of gods, nor out of curiosity.

39.s:
dakṣayajñavināśārthaṃ saṃprāpto 'haṃ surottamāḥ
vīrabhadreti vikhyāto rudrakopād viniḥsṛtaḥ //
39.d:
दक्षयज्ञविनाशार्थं संप्राप्तो ऽहं सुरोत्तमाः
वीरभद्रेति विख्यातो रुद्रकोपाद् विनिःसृतः ॥
39.m: I have arrived to destroy the sacrifice of Dakṣa, O best of gods! / Known as Vīrabhadra, I have sprung from the wrath of Rudra.

39.s:
bhadrakālī ca vikhyātā devyāḥ krodhād vinirgatā
preṣitā devadevena yajñāntikam upāgatā //
39.d:
भद्रकाली च विख्याता देव्याः क्रोधाद् विनिर्गता
प्रेषिता देवदेवेन यज्ञान्तिकम् उपागता ॥
39.m: And she is known as Bhadrakālī, issued from the anger of the goddess; / sent by the god of gods, she has come near the sacrifice.

39.s:
śaraṇaṃ gaccha rājendra devadevam umāpatim
varaṃ krodho 'pi devasya na varaḥ paricārakaiḥ //
39.d:
शरणं गच्छ राजेन्द्र देवदेवम् उमापतिम्
वरं क्रोधो ऽपि देवस्य न वरः परिचारकैः ॥
39.m: Seek refuge, O king of kings, with the god of gods, the lord of Umā! / Even the wrath of the god is a blessing; not so [the favor] of his servants.”

39.s:
brahmovāca
nikhātotpāṭitair yūpair apaviddhais tatas tataḥ
utpatadbhiḥ patadbhiś ca gṛdhrair āmiṣagṛdhnubhiḥ //
39.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
निखातोत्पाटितैर् यूपैर् अपविद्धैस् ततस् ततः
उत्पतद्भिः पतद्भिश् च गृध्रैर् आमिषगृध्नुभिः ॥
39.m: Brahmā said: / “With its sacrificial posts driven down, uprooted, and scattered here and there, / with vultures greedy for flesh flying up and swooping down,

39.s:
pakṣavātavinirdhūtaiḥ śivārutavināditaiḥ
sa tasya yajño nṛpater bādhyamānas tadā gaṇaiḥ //
39.d:
पक्षवातविनिर्धूतैः शिवारुतविनादितैः
स तस्य यज्ञो नृपतेर् बाध्यमानस् तदा गणैः ॥
39.m: buffeted by the wind of their wings, echoing with the howls of jackals, / that sacrifice of the king, being assaulted then by the gaṇas,

39.s:
āsthāya mṛgarūpaṃ vai kham evābhyapatat tadā
taṃ tu yajñaṃ tathārūpaṃ gacchantam upalabhya saḥ //
39.d:
आस्थाय मृगरूपं वै खम् एवाभ्यपतत् तदा
तं तु यज्ञं तथारूपं गच्छन्तम् उपलभ्य सः ॥
39.m: assuming the form of a deer, flew right up into the sky. / But perceiving that sacrifice fleeing in such a form, he,

39.s:
dhanur ādāya bāṇaṃ ca tadartham agamat prabhuḥ
tatas tasya gaṇeśasya krodhād amitatejasaḥ //
39.d:
धनुर् आदाय बाणं च तदर्थम् अगमत् प्रभुः
ततस् तस्य गणेशस्य क्रोधाद् अमिततेजसः ॥
39.m: the lord, taking a bow and an arrow, went after it. / Then from the wrath of that lord of gaṇas of immeasurable splendor,

39.s:
lalāṭāt prasṛto ghoraḥ svedabindur babhūva ha
tasmin patitamātre ca svedabindau tadā bhuvi //
39.d:
ललाटात् प्रसृतो घोरः स्वेदबिन्दुर् बभूव ह
तस्मिन् पतितमात्रे च स्वेदबिन्दौ तदा भुवि ॥
39.m: a dreadful drop of sweat rolled down from his forehead. / As soon as that drop of sweat fell upon the ground,

39.s:
prādurbhūto mahān agnir jvalatkālānalopamaḥ
tatrodapadyata tadā puruṣo dvijasattamāḥ //
39.d:
प्रादुर्भूतो महान् अग्निर् ज्वलत्कालानलोपमः
तत्रोदपद्यत तदा पुरुषो द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
39.m: a great fire manifested, resembling the blazing fire of cosmic dissolution. / There arose then, O best of the twice-born, a person:

39.s:
hrasvo 'timātro raktākṣo haricchmaśrur vibhīṣaṇaḥ
ūrdhvakeśo 'tiromāṅgaḥ śoṇakarṇas tathaiva ca //
39.d:
ह्रस्वो ऽतिमात्रो रक्ताक्षो हरिच्छ्मश्रुर् विभीषणः
ऊर्ध्वकेशो ऽतिरोमाङ्गः शोणकर्णस् तथैव च ॥
39.m: extremely short, red-eyed, with a tawny beard, terrifying, / hair standing on end, extremely hairy-bodied, with red ears,

39.s:
karālakṛṣṇavarṇaś ca raktavāsās tathaiva ca
taṃ yajñaṃ sa mahāsattvo 'dahat kakṣam ivānalaḥ //
39.d:
करालकृष्णवर्णश् च रक्तवासास् तथैव च
तं यज्ञं स महासत्त्वो ऽदहत् कक्षम् इवानलः ॥
39.m: of fierce black complexion and clad in red garments. / That being of great power burned that sacrifice as fire burns dry brush.

39.s:
devāś ca pradrutāḥ sarve gatā bhītā diśo daśa
tena tasmin vicaratā vikrameṇa tadā tu vai //
39.d:
देवाश् च प्रद्रुताः सर्वे गता भीता दिशो दश
तेन तस्मिन् विचरता विक्रमेण तदा तु वै ॥
39.m: And all the gods fled, scattered in fear in the ten directions. / As he strode about with that prowess at that time,

39.s:
pṛthivī vyacalat sarvā saptadvīpā samantataḥ
mahābhūte pravṛtte tu devalokabhayaṃkare //
39.d:
पृथिवी व्यचलत् सर्वा सप्तद्वीपा समन्ततः
महाभूते प्रवृत्ते तु देवलोकभयंकरे ॥
39.m: the entire earth with its seven continents trembled on all sides. / When that great being arose, terrifying to the world of the gods,

39.s:
tadā cāhaṃ mahādevam abravaṃ pratipūjayan
bhavate 'pi surāḥ sarve bhāgaṃ dāsyanti vai prabho //
39.d:
तदा चाहं महादेवम् अब्रवं प्रतिपूजयन्
भवते ऽपि सुराः सर्वे भागं दास्यन्ति वै प्रभो ॥
39.m: I then said to Mahādeva, worshiping him: / ‘All the gods will surely grant you a share too, O Lord!

39.s:
kriyatāṃ pratisaṃhāraḥ sarvadeveśvara tvayā
imāś ca devatāḥ sarvā ṛṣayaś ca sahasraśaḥ //
39.d:
क्रियतां प्रतिसंहारः सर्वदेवेश्वर त्वया
इमाश् च देवताः सर्वा ऋषयश् च सहस्रशः ॥
39.m: Let a withdrawal be made by you, O lord of all gods! / All these deities and ṛṣis by the thousands,

39.s:
tava krodhān mahādeva na śāntim upalebhire
yaś caiṣa puruṣo jātaḥ svedajas te surarṣabha //
39.d:
तव क्रोधान् महादेव न शान्तिम् उपलेभिरे
यश् चैष पुरुषो जातः स्वेदजस् ते सुरर्षभ ॥
39.m: because of your wrath, O Mahādeva, have obtained no peace. / And as for this person born of sweat, produced from you, O bull among the gods,

39.s:
jvaro nāmaiṣa dharmajña lokeṣu pracariṣyati
ekībhūtasya na hy asya dhāraṇe tejasaḥ prabho //
39.d:
ज्वरो नामैष धर्मज्ञ लोकेषु प्रचरिष्यति
एकीभूतस्य न ह्य् अस्य धारणे तेजसः प्रभो ॥
39.m: he shall roam about the worlds by the name of Jvara (Fever), O knower of dharma. / For the entire earth is not able, O Lord, to bear

39.s:
samarthā sakalā pṛthvī bahudhā sṛjyatām ayam
ity uktaḥ sa mayā devo bhāge cāpi prakalpite //
39.d:
समर्था सकला पृथ्वी बहुधा सृज्यताम् अयम्
इत्य् उक्तः स मया देवो भागे चापि प्रकल्पिते ॥
39.m: the splendor of him as a single entity; let him be divided in many ways.’ / Being addressed thus by me, and when a share was also assigned,

39.s:
bhagavān māṃ tathety āha devadevaḥ pinākadhṛk
parāṃ ca prītim agamat sa svayaṃ ca pinākadhṛk //
39.d:
भगवान् मां तथेत्य् आह देवदेवः पिनाकधृक्
परां च प्रीतिम् अगमत् स स्वयं च पिनाकधृक् ॥
39.m: the Blessed Lord, the god of gods, bearer of the Pināka bow, said ‘So be it’ to me; / and he himself, the bearer of the Pināka, experienced supreme delight.

39.s:
dakṣo 'pi manasā devaṃ bhavaṃ śaraṇam anvagāt
prāṇāpānau samārudhya cakṣuḥsthāne prayatnataḥ //
39.d:
दक्षो ऽपि मनसा देवं भवं शरणम् अन्वगात्
प्राणापानौ समारुध्य चक्षुःस्थाने प्रयत्नतः ॥
39.m: Dakṣa too sought refuge with god Bhava in his mind, / carefully restraining the prāṇa and apāna breaths at the place between the eyes.

39.s:
vidhārya sarvato dṛṣṭiṃ bahudṛṣṭir amitrajit
smitaṃ kṛtvābravīd vākyaṃ brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te //
39.d:
विधार्य सर्वतो दृष्टिं बहुदृष्टिर् अमित्रजित्
स्मितं कृत्वाब्रवीद् वाक्यं ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते ॥
39.m: The conqueror of foes, having many eyes, casting his gaze everywhere, / smiled and spoke these words: ‘Tell me, what shall I do for you?’

39.s:
śrāvite ca mahākhyāne devānāṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha
tam uvācāñjaliṃ kṛtvā dakṣo devaṃ prajāpatiḥ
bhītaḥ śaṅkitacittas tu sabāṣpavadanekṣaṇaḥ //
39.d:
श्राविते च महाख्याने देवानां पितृभिः सह
तम् उवाचाञ्जलिं कृत्वा दक्षो देवं प्रजापतिः
भीतः शङ्कितचित्तस् तु सबाष्पवदनेक्षणः ॥
39.m: When the great narrative had been recited together with the gods and the ancestors, / Dakṣa, the lord of creatures, with folded hands, said to the god, / frightened, anxious in mind, with face and eyes filled with tears:

39.s:
dakṣa uvāca
yadi prasanno bhagavān yadi vāhaṃ tava priyaḥ
yadi cāham anugrāhyo yadi deyo varo mama //
39.d:
दक्ष उवाच
यदि प्रसन्नो भगवान् यदि वाहं तव प्रियः
यदि चाहम् अनुग्राह्यो यदि देयो वरो मम ॥
39.m: Dakṣa said: / ‘If the Blessed Lord is pleased, or if I am dear to you, / if I am to be shown grace, and if a boon is to be given to me:

39.s:
yad bhakṣyaṃ bhakṣitaṃ pītaṃ trāsitaṃ yac ca nāśitam
cūrṇīkṛtāpaviddhaṃ ca yajñasaṃbhāram īdṛśam //
39.d:
यद् भक्ष्यं भक्षितं पीतं त्रासितं यच् च नाशितम्
चूर्णीकृतापविद्धं च यज्ञसंभारम् ईदृशम् ॥
39.m: Whatever food has been eaten, drunk, scattered in terror, and destroyed, / and crushed and cast away of such provisions of the sacrifice,

39.s:
dīrghakālena mahatā prayatnena ca saṃcitam
na ca mithyā bhaven mahyaṃ tvatprasādān maheśvara //
39.d:
दीर्घकालेन महता प्रयत्नेन च संचितम्
न च मिथ्या भवेन् मह्यं त्वत्प्रसादान् महेश्वर ॥
39.m: collected over a long time and with great effort— / let that not be in vain for me, by your grace, O Maheśvara!’

39.s:
brahmovāca
tathāstv ity āha bhagavān bhaganetraharo haraḥ
dharmādhyakṣaṃ mahādevaṃ tryambakaṃ ca prajāpatiḥ //
39.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच
तथास्त्व् इत्य् आह भगवान् भगनेत्रहरो हरः
धर्माध्यक्षं महादेवं त्र्यम्बकं च प्रजापतिः ॥
39.m: Brahmā said: / ‘So be it,’ said the Blessed Lord Hara, who took away the eyes of Bhaga. / And the lord of creatures [bowed] to Mahādeva, the supervisor of dharma, the three-eyed god.

39.s:
jānubhyām avanīṃ gatvā dakṣo labdhvā bhavād varam
nāmnāṃ cāṣṭasahasreṇa stutavān vṛṣabhadhvajam //
39.d:
जानुभ्याम् अवनीं गत्वा दक्षो लब्ध्वा भवाद् वरम्
नाम्नां चाष्टसहस्रेण स्तुतवान् वृषभध्वजम् ॥
39.m: Dakṣa, touching the ground with his knees, having obtained the boon from Bhava, / praised the bull-bannered god with eight thousand names.
